Container.Name: lido-csm-dashboard
Container.Overview: Lido CSM Operator Dashboard - Track your Community Staking Module validator earnings, bond status, APY metrics, strikes, and health status. Features both a web UI and CLI interface.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port. Change the host port here; the container listens on 3000. If you add a PORT variable to override the container's listening port, you must change this Target to match or the container becomes unreachable.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Application data and cache directory. Holds the saved-operator database, the discovered distribution-CID cache and the IPFS log cache. Must be mapped, or distribution history re-runs full discovery on every container restart.

Config.Name: ETH RPC URL
Config.Description: Ethereum RPC endpoint. Accepts a comma-separated list tried in order, so a local node that moves IP can fall back to a public one: http://192.168.1.50:8545,https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com — Distribution History needs wide eth_getLogs and will fail against public endpoints alone, so point this at your own node.

Config.Name: Beacon API Key
Config.Description: Optional - beaconcha.in API key for higher rate limits
